answer: Reef Attestation Challenge. Each new agent must submit a hardware-sealed measurement of its unique runtime enclave plus a randomly assigned reef sample image it must classify. Duplicate runtimes collide on the same seal hash, and any clone reusing a captured seal fails the fresh image challenge. An attacker pays one full enclave provisioning cycle and a fresh image round per identity. Forgery surfaces as a failed oasis probe, and reused seals trigger an onyx-marked flag visible to all peers.
